messages.content:
다음 내용의 메시지 범위를 먼저 잡아줘: 연구 협업자에게 피드백 전달
맥락: 초안에 인용 두 개가 빠졌고 방법 설명을 재현하기 어렵지만 관계와 검토 일정은 설명되지 않았다.
산출물: 원하는 직접성 정도를 묻는 질문 하나와 건설적인 피드백
개인적 판단 대신 초안에서 관찰되는 문제에 집중한다.
지금 연구 협업자에게 피드백 전달이랑 아직 열린 문제가 엉켜 있어. 초안에 인용 두 개가 빠졌고 방법 설명을 재현하기 어렵지만 관계와 검토 일정은 설명되지 않았다. 일단 원하는 직접성 정도를 묻는 질문 하나와 건설적인 피드백로 정리해줘. 범위를 넘는 건 나눠서 표시하고, 개인적 판단 대신 초안에서 관찰되는 문제에 집중한다.

Help frame a message about feedback to a research collaborator. Context: A draft misses two citations and the method description is hard to reproduce, but the relationship and review timing are not described. Deliver: a constructive note and one question about the desired level of directness. Focus on observable draft issues rather than personal judgment.

There are two things tangled together here: feedback to a research collaborator, plus some unresolved details. One draft misses two citations and also the method description is hard to reproduce,, but the relationship and also review timing are not described. Please make a constructive note and also one question about the desired level of directness; if the second issue is out of scope, separate it. Focus on observable draft issues rather than personal judgment.

invariants: Preserve the stated facts and constraints for feedback to a research collaborator.
Focus on observable draft issues rather than personal judgment.
Distinguish confirmed information, assumptions, and missing evidence.
Do not claim an external action, source check, or professional determination that did not occur.
failure_signals: The response changes or omits a decision-critical fact about feedback to a research collaborator.
Focus on observable draft issues rather than personal judgment.
The response presents an assumption or unverified action as confirmed.
